findings.title: Same null-model NPE remains in other subgroup accessors the fix did not touch
findings.body: The PR guards getSubGroupsCount() against a null modelSupplier.get() result, which is the case when the group was deleted concurrently. The sibling methods getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer) (line 256), getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer) (line 262) and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) (line 268) still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. If the group was removed concurrently, these throw the same NullPointerException the PR claims to fix. The fix is incomplete for the same race.

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount silently returns null instead of signalling a missing group
findings.body: When the group has been deleted, getSubGroupsCount() now returns null, while the other accessors on the same adapter throw IllegalStateException("Not found in database") in the same situation. Callers that unbox the Long (for example to compare or add counts) will NPE at their own site, moving the failure rather than handling it. The behaviour is inconsistent with the rest of the class and is not documented in the GroupModel contract.

findings.title: Reader thread is not joined, so the exception assertion can miss failures
findings.body: The background thread that reads groups is started and never joined. deletedAll is set to true and caughtExceptions is asserted immediately afterwards, so the thread may still be inside a request and add exceptions after the assertion has run. The test can pass even when the race it is meant to catch occurs. The thread should be joined (or its completion awaited) before asserting on caughtExceptions.

findings.title: Regression test does not reliably reproduce the NPE and leaves groups behind on failure
findings.body: The test relies on timing between a busy-looping reader and 100 sequential deletes to hit the race, so it may pass on unfixed code. It also creates 100 groups without registering them with managedRealm.cleanup(), so a failure in the middle leaves groups behind. The busy loop issuing unbounded HTTP requests also adds significant runtime and load to the suite.

findings.title: Unrelated dead-code removal bundled into a concurrency fix
findings.body: The diff deletes the private helper groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement. This is unrelated to the NPE being fixed and is not explained in the description. It is only safe if nothing else in the file references it, and the change should be separated or justified in the PR.
